row.notes: mov rax,[rax+rdi*8+0xb8] in Ai_Job_UpdateCarsParallel (+0x232e), 8 bytes, no branch lands inside it. rsi = the car's gap evaluation result (pbVar5+0x60 or +0xb0, the later Ai_Overtake_EvaluateGap results), rax = [rsi+8] = the next corner start line Ai_TrackLine_FindNextCornerStart stored (0 when the route's corner start table has no usable entry ahead; result+0x4b stays 1), rdi = car index ([rbx+0x178]). The preceding cmp byte [rsi+0x4b],0 / je tests only the valid flag, so rax 0 faults reading 0xb8 (jonno_aus, local.adelaide-skeleton, 1.7.5; Nordschleife r71b). The next instructions test rax and take 0x1406409be, the game's own no-corner-line path. Core's AI corner guard sends rax 0 there. Raise to L2 needs ai-re.  ai-re L2 2026-11-01: independent decomp and disasm; 14066e830 writes result+8=0 on its break exits and at its tail, so rax from mov rax,[rsi+8] can be 0 and the load at +0xb8 faults; the null test on the next insn is too late. CORRECTION 2026-11-16 (engine-re racing-line round, static): result+8 holds the next BRAKE LINE (lane+0x498 = channel 1 = brake_line elements, 0xc8 bytes, type 1), not a corner start; +0xb8+route*8 is a per-route field of that element. The guard logic is unaffected; only the wording corner start is wrong. edited by engine-re with --force 2026-11-16 at user request (lane owner review requested)
